node: Learning management systems, campus software, identity, assessment, and cybersecurity
summary: Expanded universe for the learning-infrastructure/security node should look beyond public LMS pure plays because major LMS/SIS assets such as Instructure and PowerSchool have been taken private. The underappreciated public-market mapping is therefore identity, secure access, endpoint protection, online assessment/proctoring, and education data-management vendors that sit around private LMS/SIS systems and become more necessary as schools move more workflows online and face cybersecurity, AI-cheating, and data-governance pressure.
